The current TIAGo controller contains a separate adaptation/integration layer, including world-to-GATO wrench-frame conversion and TIAGo-specific parameters. The blocker is provenance and evidence for the intended adapted experiment: exact adaptation revision/configuration, model and hypothesis inputs, and linked raw outputs are not established. E01/E02/E03 must not treat generic source or unrelated artifacts as a faithful adapted comparison.

sources.role: Adaptation/integration lead. Constructs estimator for batch >1 with radius 5/2/20 and smoothing .5; generates hypotheses, transforms each wrench from world through end-effector to GATO frame, sets the solver batch wrench, chooses the best lane by one-step state prediction error, then updates estimator with alpha=.6 and beta=.5.
sources.relevance: Identifies the local adapted control flow, parameters and stated frame conversion needed for a correspondence protocol.
sources.limitations: No retained provenance says this exact controller revision was the adaptation originally measured. Frame conversion has not been independently qualified here. The Python interface and compiled CUDA binding explicitly reject nonzero wrench for TIAGo (see hashed entries below), so this tree does not establish an executable nonzero-wrench TIAGo solver experiment.
